title: Investigation and Order Passing
description: Investigation by the Central Authority and passing of orders for violation of consumer rights or unfair trade practice

steps.step: Satisfaction of sufficient evidence to show violation of consumer rights or unfair trade practice
Giving the person an opportunity of being heard
Passing of order by the Central Authority

documents: order recalling goods or withdrawal of services
order for reimbursement of prices of goods or services
order for discontinuation of unfair practices
